conversation.text: You said you feel little support. What is happening?
Team lead is on Europe calls all day, so when I get stuck on billing disputes my messages sit until the next morning. A daily 15-minute slot or a backup person to ask would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: The team lead is occupied with overseas calls during the day, causing delays in receiving assistance for billing issues. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "Team lead is on Europe calls all day, so when I get stuck on billing disputes my messages sit until the next morning."
